findings.evidence: The minimum length is a constant (8) and also spelled out as text in the too-short message, so changing one leaves the other stale.
findings.why_it_matters: The message could contradict the rule it reports.
findings.required_action: Build the message from the constant if the length is ever changed; low risk while the server rule is fixed at 8.

findings.evidence: build() is short, but the helper it calls lays out the whole column in one method; the sign-in page splits the same shape into a private _LoginCard widget.
findings.why_it_matters: Slightly harder to scan than the sibling page.
findings.required_action: Optional: extract the column into a private widget as the login page does.

findings.evidence: Everything is tested against mocked repositories and a mocked bloc. The real round trip (backend flags mustChangePassword, the app forces the change, other devices are signed out) was not exercised.
findings.why_it_matters: A contract drift such as a renamed response field would only show up against the running API.
findings.required_action: Run once against a dev API: create a student, e-mail the temporary password, sign in on pte-app, change it, then confirm another signed-in device is logged out.
